inference.inheritance: Use the same source-fixed-effect + target-fixed-effect, two-way source/target cluster-robust one-sided beta_R test that passed the prospective host-resource study. It is requalified on Study B development geometry rather than assumed valid.
inference.fallback_after_failure: none; a failed formal qualification is NOT_EVALUABLE, not authority to choose another estimator

synthetic_worlds.seed_rule: uint64 from first 16 hex characters of SHA256('<namespace>|<opportunity_design_sha256>|<cell_name>')
synthetic_worlds.private_structure: source-specific slope on z_geographic_coverage plus target-specific slope on centered_same_order; each slope SD = 0.12*A

relational_positive_cell.name: environment_relation_A3_beta0p03
relational_positive_cell.rationale: Same standardized minimally meaningful relational-effect floor used prospectively for Study A; fixed independently of Study B R_env or genetic outcomes.

gates.predictor_condition_number: < 1e4 after exact two-way FE absorption on development eligible dyads
gates.private_type1: Wilson 95% upper bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate <=0.10 for every frozen private-null cell
gates.relational_power: Wilson 95% lower bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate >=0.80 for environment_relation_A3_beta0p03

after_development_pass: Only then may the confirmatory panel open canonical-valid/noncanonical masks. Nucleotide identity remains closed until exact confirmatory survivor geometry reruns this same qualification rule and passes.
forbidden: change beta_R floor after seeing environment relation or Study B genetic response
change world generator, estimator, alpha, or Wilson gates after formal results
use Study A host-resource empirical result as a tuning input
interpret qualification failure as evidence that environmental similarity lacks biological effect
